670.n: epic 3rd-decl. plural υἷες; υἷες Ἀχαιῶν 'sons of the Achaeans', i.e. the Achaeans

671.n: = δειδέχατο; plpf. of δείδεγμαι 'greet, pledge (with the cup)', filed under δείκνυμι
in tmesis: ἐκ … ἐρέοντο; from epic ἐρέομαι, uncontracted, unaugmented

672.n: unaugmented; epic ἐρεείνω 'ask', with ἐξ- 'question closely'

673.n: = μοι, elided (rare; as 6.165), with εἰπέ: 'tell me'; some take it as με
with κῦδος, in apposition to Ὀδυσεῦ
μέγα κῦδος Ἀχαιῶν 'great glory of the Achaeans', in address

674.n: ἤ … ἦ (675) 'whether … or', in a direct question; accent from enclitic ῥʼ
epic dat. pl. -εσσι(ν) (Attic ναυσί); dative with ἀλεξέμεναι

675.n: second member of ἤ … ἦ 'whether … or', accented ἦ; not ἦ 'truly'

678.n: epic κεῖνος = ἐκεῖνος; second accent from enclitic γʼ

679.n: epic by-form πιμπλάνω of πίμπλημι; + gen. 'is filled with'
uncontracted gen. (Attic μένους); genitive with πιμπλάνεται

682.n: = ἅμα; ἅμʼ ἠοῖ φαινομένηφι 'when dawn appears'

682.p: verb · pres. part. mid. dat. sg. fem.
682.n: epic -φι ending, here dative: 'with dawn appearing'

683.n: epithet of ships (or 'rowed on both sides')

684.n: with the infinitive παραμυθήσασθαι: 'that he would advise'

685.n: epic = τέκμαρ 'fixed mark': the end appointed for Ilios, its fall

686.n: epic enclitic gen. ἑθεν = οὗ; with ὑπερέσχε (687): over Ilios

687.n: aorist ὑπερέσχον; 'hold (a hand) over' + gen., in protection

688.n: = ἔφατο; Achilles, as Odysseus reports him

689.n: dual; the heralds Odius and Eurybates (9.170)

689.p: verb · pf. part. mid./pass. nom. du. masc.
689.n: dual; perfect participle used as adjective 'wise, sensible'

690.n: = αὖθι, elided: 'there, on the spot' (in Achilles' hut); not αὖτε
aorist middle of καταλέγω 'lay down': 'lay down to sleep'; not καταλέγω 'recount'
ὡς γὰρ ἀνώγει 'for so he bade'
unaugmented pluperfect (= ἠνώγει) with imperfect sense

691.n: purpose clause with subjunctive; second accent from enclitic οἱ
= πατρίδα; used as a noun: 'native land'

692.n: Achilles' ἄξω (9.429), reported in the third person

694.p: verb · aor. part. mid. nom. pl. masc.
694.n: epic -σσ-; 'be astonished at': struck dumb by the answer (as 8.29)

695.n: 'in silence'; or nom. pl. of an adjective ἄνεως

695.p: verb · pf. part. act. nom. pl. masc.
695.n: active perfect participle τετιηώς, present sense: 'troubled, dejected'
epic 3rd-decl. plural υἷες; υἷες Ἀχαιῶν 'sons of the Achaeans', i.e. the Achaeans

696.n: acc. of respect: βοὴν ἀγαθός 'good at the war cry'

698.n: with ὄφελες: 'would that you had not'
unaugmented aor. ὄφελον + inf.: unattainable wish

699.p: verb · pres. part. act. nom. sg. masc.

700.n: κ-aorist of ἐνίημι 'send in': 'plunged (him) into', + dat.

701.n: short-vowel aorist subjunctive (= ἐάσωμεν), hortatory; or future 'we will let (him) be'

702.n: second member of ἤ … ἦ 'whether … or', accented ἦ; not ἦ 'truly'
with the subjunctive; accent from enclitic μιν

703.n: perfect with present sense; subjunctive with ὁππότε κεν (702)

704.n: = ἄγετε (τ → θ before rough breathing); 'come on!'

705.p: verb · aor. part. mid. nom. pl. masc.
705.n: reduplicated aorist middle (τεταρπόμην); + gen. 'having had your fill of'

706.n: 'that (food and wine)' is might and courage

707.n: Ionic Ἠώς = Attic Ἕως; the goddess

708.n: epic inf. -έμεν (= ἔχειν); infinitive for imperative: 'marshal, keep (in line)'

709.p: verb · pres. part. act. nom. sg. masc.

709.n: epic dat. pl. -οισι; substantive: 'the front ranks'

710.n: with βασιλῆες in apposition: 'they, all the kings'
